card.name: Mixed words before a continuing phrase
card.fires_on: Scattered words in the middle of a clause or name, such as 'life' before '-threatening', 'initial' after 'During the', or a first name before a surname. No single word type unites them.

modes.label: Clinical phrase openers
modes.description: A word that starts a set phrase in dosing or treatment text, with the rest of the phrase still to come.
modes.example: patients with<< life>>-threatening ventricular arrhythmias who are

modes.label: Person names in citations
modes.description: A first name or name fragment in a researcher or author name.
modes.example: senior author<< Christina>> A. Meyers, Ph.D.,

modes.label: Condition clauses
modes.description: A verb or noun inside an 'as long as the patient...' benefit clause.
modes.example: as long as the patient<< is>> deriving benefit.
